# Life of Adam and Eve Chapter 43 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Latin MS (Vita Adae et Evae) | **Section:** The Serpent and the Fall Recounted

---

**1** 'The serpent came to me and said craftily: "Why don't you eat from the tree in the middle of the garden? God knows that when you eat it your eyes will be opened."'

**2** 'I was deceived by the serpent's words and ate from the tree. I also gave some to your father, and he ate.'

**3** 'Right away our eyes were opened and we realized we were naked, and we were ashamed.'

---
*PNEUMA: modern English; verse-only numbering.*
